mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_TABLE T
ORDER BY
T.ID

choose.when: SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT UPPER(COL.TABLE_NAME) TABLENAME, UPPER(COL.COLUMN_NAME) FIELDNAME, COL.UDT_NAME FIELDTYPE, CASE COL.IS_NULLABLE WHEN 'YES' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ALLOWNULL, CASE COL.UDT_NAME WHEN 'varchar' THEN COL.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH ELSE NULL END FIELDLENGTH, REPLACE(COALESCE(COL.COLUMN_DEFAULT, ''), '''', '') DEFAULTVALUE, COL.NUMERIC_PRECISION "PRECISION", COL.NUMERIC_SCALE "SCALE", COALESCE(DES.DESCRIPTION, '') FIELDCOMMENT FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS COL LEFT JOIN PG_DESCRIPTION DES ON COL.TABLE_NAME ::REGCLASS = DES.OBJOID AND COL.ORDINAL_POSITION = DES.OBJSUBID WHERE COL.TABLE_SCHEMA = CURRENT_SCHEMA() ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION) T
choose.otherwise: SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT COL.TABLE_NAME TABLENAME, COL.COLUMN_NAME FIELDNAME, COL.DATA_TYPE FIELDTYPE, CASE COL.DATA_TYPE WHEN 'VARCHAR2' THEN TO_CHAR(COL.DATA_LENGTH) ELSE '' END FIELDLENGTH, DECODE(COL.NULLABLE, 'Y', '1', '0') ALLOWNULL, REPLACE(NVL(DECODE(LONG_TO_CHAR(COL.TABLE_NAME, COL.COLUMN_ID), 'NULL', '', LONG_TO_CHAR(COL.TABLE_NAME, COL.COLUMN_ID)), ''), '''', '') DEFAULTVALUE, --LONG_TO_CHAR()依赖自定义的函数转换,NULL为了规避掉默认值不能删除 NVL(COM.COMMENTS, '') FIELDCOMMENT, DECODE(COL.DATA_TYPE, 'NUMBER', NVL(COL.DATA_PRECISION, 19), NULL) PRECISION, DECODE(COL.DATA_TYPE, 'NUMBER', NVL(COL.DATA_SCALE, 0), NULL) SCALE FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS COL LEFT JOIN USER_COL_COMMENTS COM ON COL.TABLE_NAME = COM.TABLE_NAME AND COL.COLUMN_NAME = COM.COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY COL.COLUMN_ID) T
